message.reasoning_content:
I need to determine the additional clockwise angle in degrees, relative to the reference image, that aligns the target object's facing direction with the reference direction.

The reference direction is indicated by the finger in image 1, pointing upper-right. Looking at the current object in image 2, its facing direction is downward.

The reference angle is 45 degrees (upper-right direction). The current angle of the target object is 0 degrees (downward).

The difference between the reference angle and the current angle is 45 - 0 = 45 degrees. This is the clockwise angle needed.
